initialize_ASEWAI_dataset: initialize an ASEWAI dataset with a specific split, root directory, and resolution for synthetic indoor scene data
load_ASEWAI_scenes: load precomputed scene metadata from numpy files for a given train, val, or test split
sample_ASEWAI_views: sample N views from an ASE scene using pairwise covisibility and return image, depth, and camera data
run_ASEWAI_cli: run the ASE dataset CLI module to load and visualize scenes with rerun 3D logging
review_ASEWAI_get_views: review the ASEWAI _get_views method that loads frames, resizes images, and extracts camera intrinsics and poses
